run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T15:14:48Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend-proxy (opened 2026-11-16T15:14:48Z, annotation citing a current value of 0.6444) is explained by HTTP 500s on the checkout route only. frontend-proxy's own ingress and router frontend egress spans carry error=true with http.status_code=500, and the trace chain runs load-generator -> frontend-proxy ingress -> frontend POST /api/checkout -> frontend grpc CheckoutService/PlaceOrder -> checkout PlaceOrder -> checkout HTTP POST -> shipping /get-quote (500) -> shipping's outbound POST to quote (QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080) which dies at a fixed ~5.0005 s deadline with status description "Timeout". The deepest supported finding is that the failed attempts never reach the quote service: quote's inbound span rate equals shipping's successful-call rate at every timestep, quote's p95 latency is a flat ~1.9 ms with no error series and its logs show only normal "Calculated quote" lines, so quote's request handling is not the failing element. About 84% of shipping->quote attempts failed at the 15:20-15:26Z peak while total attempt rate stayed steady. Pods, nodes and resource signals are clean (all 21 otel-demo pods Running/ready with 0 restarts, five nodes Ready with no pressure, CPU in the millicore range, CFS throttling at most 8.5% of periods). The initiating mechanism (packet loss/stall versus name-resolution failure on the shipping->quote path, possibly an injected experiment) could not be determined from the authorized sources, so the conclusion is partial and no single root-cause object is asserted. Note: checkout's propagated error text names the email service ("failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"), which contradicts the observed routing, shipping's configuration and checkout's own successful email confirmations; that inconsistency is reported verbatim and left unresolved.

claims.text: frontend-proxy recorded 407.66 ERROR span-increases on operation "ingress" and 384.34 on "router frontend egress" over the 77-minute window ending 15:32:13Z, against 24252.85 and 24274.14 UNSET span-increases on the same two operations.

frontend-proxy "ingress" ERROR rate (5-minute rate) stayed between 0.0037 and 0.0185 spans/s from 14:53:48Z to 15:13:48Z, then rose to 0.0444 at 15:15:48Z, 0.2667 at 15:17:48Z, 0.4556 at 15:19:48Z and 0.447-0.489 spans/s through 15:27:48Z (0.2583 at 15:29:48Z), while traffic (UNSET) remained roughly 9-10 spans/s; pod start times in the same view are 14:37:59-14:39:48Z, so the error ramp began around 15:15Z, not at pod creation.

Error spans in the window are confined to the checkout path: frontend "POST /api/checkout" 382.31, frontend "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" 382.31, frontend "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" 382.31, checkout "HTTP POST" 382.72, checkout "oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" 382.72, shipping "/get-quote" 385.04, shipping "POST quote" 385.04, frontend-proxy "ingress" 407.66 and "router frontend egress" 384.34; the same breakdown returned 0 error spans for frontend "GET", "GET /api/cart", "GET /api/data", "POST /api/cart", "grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart", "grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds" and "tcp.connect".

Whole trace cfdf4d5ad0a694a5b21b34e15dc11411 shows, by parent references, load-generator POST (500) -> frontend-proxy ingress (http.status_code 500) -> frontend POST /api/checkout (500) -> frontend grpc CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13) -> checkout PlaceOrder (13) -> checkout prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart -> checkout "HTTP POST" (error, 5.002531 s) -> shipping "/get-quote" (error, "Internal Server Error", 5.001042 s) -> shipping "POST quote" (error, "Timeout", 5.000995 s); no quote-service span appears anywhere in that trace.

The failing shipping client spans sit on a fixed deadline: shipping "POST quote" spans measured 5000448, 5000518, 5000995, 5001042, 5001336 and 5001391 microseconds (5.0004-5.0014 s) with otel.status_description "Timeout", and the matching shipping "/get-quote" server spans report "Internal Server Error" in the same 5.0005-5.0014 s range.

The error text propagated up the chain is exactly "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500", carried as checkout otel.status_description/exception.message and frontend exception.message/grpc.error_message.

Over the 77-minute window shipping "POST quote" had 385.04 ERROR and 957.30 UNSET span-increases, and quote's own server spans total 957.30 each ("POST /getquote", "calculate-quote", "{closure}"), all STATUS_CODE_UNSET, so the failed shipping attempts have no matching quote-side span.

Time series of shipping "POST quote" by status (5-minute rate): UNSET 0.5296-0.5630 spans/s with no ERROR series through 15:14Z; then UNSET 0.4185 / ERROR 0.1211 at 15:17Z; UNSET 0.0852 / ERROR 0.4481 at 15:20Z; UNSET 0.0926 / ERROR 0.4630 at 15:23Z; UNSET 0.0889 / ERROR 0.4481 at 15:26Z; UNSET 0.0405 / ERROR 0.3420 at 15:29Z, i.e. about 84% of attempts failing at the peak while the total attempt rate stayed around 0.53-0.56 spans/s. quote's inbound "POST /getquote" series has only UNSET and matches the successful side exactly (0.0852, 0.0926, 0.0889, 0.0405).

Latency from the span-duration histogram (p95, 10-minute windows): quote "POST /getquote" stayed 1.900-1.940 ms at every point from 15:10Z to 15:31Z and shipping "/ship-order" stayed 1.900-1.935 ms, while shipping "/get-quote" and "POST quote" moved from 51.7-57.8 ms (15:10-15:16Z) to 9159 ms at 15:19Z and 9569-9708 ms at 15:22-15:31Z; those multi-second values are histogram_quantile interpolation inside a sparse bucket, not measured latencies.

Cumulative duration buckets for shipping "POST quote" (20-minute increase to 15:30Z, total 637.79): le=2 ms 195.68, le=100 ms 215.04, le=1000 ms 216.06, le=5000 ms 252.75, le=10000 ms 637.79, +Inf 637.79, i.e. about 215 span-increases at or under 100 ms, about 37 between 1 s and 5 s, and about 385 above 5 s.

Deployment configuration: shipping has env QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 and no email address, with resources limits cpu 5m / memory 15Mi; checkout has SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080 and EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080; quote runs with QUOTE_PORT=8080 and limits cpu 5m / memory 40Mi; all use image tag 2.1.3 with one replica each.

The quote Service resolves to exactly one endpoint, 100.96.1.165:8080, with targetRef quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w; that pod is owned by ReplicaSet quote-6b5877698d, which is owned by Deployment quote (shipping likewise by Deployment shipping via ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84).

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running with ready=true and restartCount 0, including quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk and email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5; their start times are 14:37:59-14:39:48Z, about 35 minutes before the error onset, and no container shows a last termination reason.

CPU-throttling ratio (throttled CFS periods / total periods) stayed low across 14:53:48-15:28:00Z: quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w 0.042-0.085, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv 0.025-0.074, checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk 0.

Per-pod CPU usage is in the millicore range (quote about 0.0024 cores before 15:20Z and about 0.0006 after, shipping about 0.0015, largest consumer otel-collector about 0.11 cores), and all five nodes report Ready with 4 CPUs / ~16 GB allocatable and no pressure conditions.

shipping's own logs show requests entering the handler as "Requesting quote" and completions logged as "Sending Quote" / "Tracking ID Created" (newest lines 15:24:07-15:24:47Z), while quote's logs contain only normal "Calculated quote" lines (newest 25 lines 15:20:39-15:24:37Z).

checkout logged successful order-confirmation sends throughout the incident, e.g. "order confirmation email sent to \"mark@example.com\"" at 15:20:37Z among many between 15:18:39Z and 15:24:37Z, so checkout's POST to the email service returned 200 for orders it completed.
The email service reported 960.34 spans for "POST /send_order_confirmation", 960.34 for "send_email" and 1920.68 for "sinatra.render_template", all STATUS_CODE_UNSET, over the same window.

Total ERROR span-increases over the 77-minute window by service were checkout 765.44 and frontend 1529.24 and shipping 770.09 and frontend-proxy 792, versus ad 3.05, fraud-detection 3.04, recommendation 3.04, accounting 0 and payment 0; nothing in the evidence ties the small ad/fraud-detection/recommendation counts to the checkout path or to this alert.

The cluster contains a chaos-mesh namespace with 7 Running chaos pods (3 chaos-controller-manager, 4 chaos-daemon, 0 restarts), cilium and coredns pods in kube-system are Running with 0 restarts, and the frontend-proxy service exposes exactly the operations "ingress" and "router frontend egress".

quote shows no fault in its own signals: its /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure} spans are 957.30 each with STATUS_CODE_UNSET and no ERROR series, its p95 latency is a flat 1.900-1.940 ms before and during the incident, and its logs contain only "Calculated quote"; the lost attempts are therefore missing before quote is entered, not mishandled by quote.

Resource exhaustion and pod damage are not supported: all otel-demo pods are Running/ready with 0 restarts and no last termination reason, all nodes are Ready with no pressure, per-pod CPU is in the millicore range and CFS throttling is at most 8.5% of periods.

The email service is not implicated in the failed orders: the failing traces contain no email span, the failure occurs at shipping's outbound call which is configured only toward http://quote:8080, and checkout logged successful email confirmations during the incident.
A stale or duplicate quote endpoint is not supported by the object state: the quote Service resolves to exactly one address (100.96.1.165) pointing at the single running pod quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w.

Rejected: that the quote service itself was slow or failing and thereby caused the shipping timeouts. quote's server spans show no errors, its p95 stays at about 1.9 ms, its inbound rate equals only the successful shipping calls, and its logs show normal quote calculations.

Rejected as the cause of these 500s: that the email service returning HTTP 500 broke checkout directly. The deepest failing hop observed is checkout->shipping->quote, the failing traces contain no email span, and checkout successfully POSTed order confirmations to email during the window; the words "failed POST to email service" inside the propagated message remain unexplained rather than confirmed.

Best-supported remaining cause: a connection-level impairment on the shipping->quote path, so that a large share of attempts never reach quote and die on the fixed ~5 s client deadline. Support: failures are pinned at 5.0004-5.0014 s, quote's inbound rate tracks only the successes one-for-one, about 84% of attempts failed at the peak (15:20-15:26Z), a minority of spans still complete in 1-5 s (retransmit-like behaviour), and no application, CPU or memory signal explains it. Packet loss or blackholing (or a saturated accept path) on that edge is consistent with all of this.

Not separable from the above with the available data: intermittent name resolution of the "quote" hostname from inside the shipping pod. quote is shipping's only dependency (QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080) and no other workload shows failing outbound calls, so a fault scoped to shipping's pod (for example a DNS-scoped fault) would produce exactly this asymmetric pattern; this Run has no DNS or network metrics to distinguish it from packet loss.

Mechanism, unverified: an injected fault experiment on the shipping/quote network path. A healthy chaos-mesh control plane (3 controllers, 4 daemons) is deployed in this cluster, which is a plausible vehicle for loss, delay or DNS effects, but no experiment object or controller log could be read in this Run, so this remains a hypothesis only.

Inspect Chaos Mesh experiment resources (NetworkChaos, DNSChaos, StressChaos and similar) in the otel-demo namespace and chaos-controller-manager logs around 15:15Z to confirm or exclude an injected fault between shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w.

On node i-0b4b26fa385533a10 (which hosts both shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w), check packet loss/retransmits and conntrack for traffic to quote's endpoint 100.96.1.165:8080 (for example cilium monitor, node packet capture, conntrack counters) and verify DNS resolution of "quote" from inside the shipping container.

Give the failing hop its own signal and alert: only two trace metrics exist in this target (traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket) and there is no rpc_client error/latency series, so shipping->quote client failures are currently visible only indirectly as frontend-proxy 5xx; add a client-error/latency alert scoped to service shipping operation "POST quote".

gaps: The alerting rule named RequestErrorRate could not be verified: the rule listing returned no rules (status no_data), so the alert expression, threshold and its stated current value 0.6444 are unconfirmed.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so what changed shortly before the ~15:15Z error ramp could not be inspected.

Chaos Mesh experiment objects could not be listed with the permitted resource kinds and chaos-controller-manager log reads returned no lines (status no_data), so an injected fault on the shipping->quote path is unverified.

Reads of the email pod logs returned 0 lines / 0 bytes (status no_data), so email-side failures cannot be excluded from email's own logs; only checkout's success logs and email's trace spans were available.

No node or pod network metrics (packet drops, retransmits, conntrack, DNS latency) exist in this target, so packet loss/stall versus name-resolution failure on the shipping->quote path cannot be distinguished.
Filtered error-log searches on the shipping and quote pods returned no matching lines (status no_data); that absence is not proof that nothing was logged.
Warning-event queries for otel-demo returned no data (status no_data) for 15:14:42-15:23:42Z, so no event-based evidence of restarts or evictions is available either way.

The propagated error text names the email service ("failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500") although shipping is configured only with QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 and the failing hop is checkout->shipping->quote; the wording could not be reconciled with the configuration or routing.

Trace data comes from a sampled, in-memory Jaeger view; the absence of quote-side spans for the failed attempts is consistent with the metrics (inbound equalling successful calls) but a sampling artifact cannot be fully excluded.
The 5-minute rate series fall to 0 at the 15:31:48Z step with source data ending 15:31:48Z, so whether the failure continued or eased after about 15:29Z is unknown.
rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count with non-zero rpc_grpc_status_code returned no series (status no_data), so gRPC-level error attribution was unavailable.

Small error-span counts were observed for ad, fraud-detection and recommendation (about 3 each over 77 minutes); nothing links them to this cause, and they are recorded as unexplained rather than as impact.
next_steps: Review Chaos Mesh custom resources and controller events for otel-demo covering roughly 15:10-15:32Z.
Run packet-level and DNS diagnostics between the shipping and quote pods, and on the node they share, during a reproduction.
Confirm from Prometheus/Alertmanager configuration which metric backs RequestErrorRate and whether 0.6444 refers to frontend-proxy ingress errors or to the checkout route ratio.
